metadata.description: Plug-and-play Claude skills for small businesses.

plugins.name: hooks
plugins.description: Give it 10 viral videos from your niche and it writes 30 hooks for your business, picks the 5 to film first, and sets up comment-keyword DMs with Postkey.

plugins.name: repurpose
plugins.description: Turns one video, podcast or newsletter transcript into a week of posts in your voice, then schedules them with Postkey when you ask.

plugins.name: business-brain
plugins.description: Builds your business brain: seven files with your offer, customers, goals and tone of voice, so Claude writes like you.

plugins.name: reply-drafter
plugins.description: Finds customer emails waiting on you and drafts replies in your voice.

plugins.name: follow-up
plugins.description: Finds quotes, leads, unpaid invoices and quiet past customers, and drafts the nudge.

plugins.name: daily-brief
plugins.description: A weekday morning brief: calendar, replies waiting, follow-ups and today's one thing.

plugins.name: brain-score
plugins.description: Scores your Claude setup out of 100 with the top 3 fixes.

plugins.name: my-business-kit
plugins.description: Seven skills that make Claude run the busywork of a small business: a business brain, inbox replies, follow-ups, a week of posts, 30 hooks from viral videos, a morning brief, and a score for your setup. Everything is drafted for you to review; nothing is sent on its own.
